rust_summary: a dropped item reaching its lifetime (`native_item_expire`).
doc_summary: `native_item_expire(entity, stack, extra_life)`, a dropped item reaching its lifetime on the server (NeoForge's `ItemExpireEvent`, vanilla `ItemEntity.tick`): every mod may set or add to `extra_life`, in ticks from zero; a positive total keeps the item that much longer, zero or less lets it expire. Extensions are capped at 32766 ticks. Bundles need "hooks": @API:item_expire@.
